evidence.quote: Collectively these results show for the first time that transcriptional profiling allows the identification before vaccination, albeit with a moderate accuracy, of participants that will mount a poor response to the HBV vaccine.

Here we show, using transcriptional and cytometric profiling of whole blood collected before vaccination, that heightened expression of genes that augment B-cell responses and higher memory B-cell frequencies correlate with stronger responses to HBV vaccine.
This moderately accurate (area under the curve≈65%) but robust signature is supported by flow cytometry and cytokine profiling.
